description: Shared dependency policy for LedFx repositories. Extend it, do not copy it.

packageRules.description: npm waits 14 days like everything else. config:best-practices extends security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm (3 days) as a package rule, which beats the top-level value; this later rule wins. Only minor and patch: update types without a release timestamp (pin, bump, lockFileMaintenance) must not wait or they wait forever.
Majors soak for a month. A person reviews them anyway, so the wait costs nobody anything.

Non-majors merge themselves once CI is green. Renovate will not automerge a branch with no passing checks, so a repo without CI merges nothing. That is not a gate: only branch protection with required checks is.
Majors always wait for a person.
